Name: LivingNPCs
Description:
[size=5][b]LivingNPCs[/b][/size]
[i]Your villagers remember, feel, and quietly act on what happens between you.[/i]
[i]让村民记住、在意，并悄悄回应你们之间发生的一切。[/i]

[list]
[*][b]Personal conversations.[/b] Replies reflect the NPC's personality, your relationship, and the world around you.[/*]
[*][b]Lasting memories.[/b] Preferences, promises, and shared experiences can shape later conversations.[/*]
[*][b]More to share.[/b] NPCs may ask for help, offer gifts, or join you for a short outing.[/*]
[*][b]Your Memory Book.[/b] Browse relationships, memories, past conversations, and shared moments.[/*]
[/list][b]Version 0.2.1 | Vanilla + SVE | English + Simplified Chinese[/b]
中文安装与使用教程请展开本页下方的「中文说明」。

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/rewrite/docs/nexus/images/headings/getting-started.png[/img][/center]
[b]You need:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.x, [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.1.0+[/url], and an AI service or local model server. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is optional but recommended.
[b]No model or API key is included.[/b] Check your provider's pricing and limits; a preset's default model is not necessarily free.

[b]Updating from 0.1.x?[/b] Read Updating below before launching this version for the first time.
[list=1]
[*]Exit the game. Unzip into Mods so the path is [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/manifest.json[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI. Open [b]GMCM → LivingNPCs → AI Dialogue Engine[/b], choose your provider, then [b]save and reopen the menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Enter the API key, exact model name, and server address where required. Save. For Ollama or LM Studio, load a model and start its local server first; no API key is needed.[/*]
[/list][center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/rewrite/docs/nexus/images/headings/how-to-play.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Chat:[/b] approach an NPC and hold [b]LeftAlt[/b] while clicking or using the interaction button.[/*]
[*][b]Memory Book:[/b] press [b]LeftShift + J[/b] to browse relationships, memories, and conversations.[/*]
[*][b]Cancel a reply:[/b] press [b]Esc / gamepad B[/b] during generation.[/*]
[/list]Plain right-click keeps vanilla dialogue by default. Both main hotkeys can be changed in GMCM. Clearly accepted item requests appear in your quest log; deliver the requested items to complete them.

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/rewrite/docs/nexus/images/headings/config-options.png[/img][/center]
In [b]GMCM → LivingNPCs[/b], you can:
[list]
[*]Enable AI for ordinary right-click conversations.[/*]
[*]Turn off [b]AI world actions[/b] to keep conversations without effects such as gifts, money, or outings.[/*]
[*]Adjust help-request, small-gift, and AI-dialogue frequencies, change hotkeys, or disable selected NPCs.[/*]
[/list]Start with [b]Thinking level: Auto[/b]. If AI dialogue was disabled at game startup, restart after enabling it. Advanced config.json options are covered in Detailed Guide.

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/rewrite/docs/nexus/images/headings/compatibility.png[/img][/center]
[b]NPCs:[/b] vanilla and SVE information is built in; SVE is optional. Other custom NPCs use a generic fallback. [b]Ridgeside Village NPCs are currently excluded from AI dialogue.[/b]

[b]Online co-op:[/b] the host and participating farmhands need the same mod version and their own AI connections. Outings are host-only; secondary split-screen players do not currently have AI dialogue support.

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/rewrite/docs/nexus/images/headings/updating.png[/img][/center]
[b]0.2.0 → 0.2.1:[/b] exit the game and back up your save and mod folder. Extract the package into Mods and merge/overwrite the existing LivingNPCs folder. Keep your settings, data, histories, conversation logs, and custom NPC files; do not delete the whole folder or load two copies.
[b]From 0.2.0 to 0.2.1[/b]
Exit the game and back up your save and LivingNPCs folder. Extract the package into Mods and merge/overwrite the existing LivingNPCs folder. Keep your config.json, data, multiplayer history, conversation_logs, and any custom npc_profiles or npc_bios files. Do not delete the whole folder or load two copies of the mod.

[b]From 0.1.x:[/b] before the first launch, rename the [b]outermost[/b] [font=Courier New]Mods/ValleyTalk[/font] folder to [font=Courier New]Mods/.ValleyTalk[/font] and keep it inside Mods. Follow [b]Detailed Guide → Updating[/b] below for the full migration steps.
[b]From 0.1.x: prepare the old ValleyTalk folder first[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Exit the game and back up your save and old mod folders.[/*]
[*]Before the first launch of the new version, rename the [b]outermost[/b] old [font=Courier New]Mods/ValleyTalk[/font] folder to [font=Courier New]Mods/.ValleyTalk[/font]. Keep it inside Mods so the importer can find it. For a ValleyTalk/ValleyTalk layout, rename the outer folder. Do not rename LivingNPCs.[/*]
[*]Extract the package into Mods and merge/overwrite the existing LivingNPCs folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, load each save you want to migrate, and make a normal in-game save afterward. The host must do this for multiplayer saves.[/*]
[/list]Compatible settings, dialogue memories, transcripts, and token records can be imported. Keep .ValleyTalk as a backup until you have checked the results. No migration message may appear if there is no old data to import.

If old ValleyTalk is still loaded, AI dialogue and migration are disabled. If you launched the new version before renaming the old folder, you may need to enter connection settings manually. For a partial migration, keep the backup and include a SMAPI log in your report.

LivingNPCs 0.2.1 includes its own dialogue engine. ValleyTalk and Content Patcher are not required for this mod.

[size=4][b]AI Setup — providers, keys & local models[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]AI Setup — providers, keys & local models[/b][/size][/center]
[b]Using a hosted AI service[/b]
Create an API key in your provider's API dashboard and check which models your account can use. Choose the matching provider in GMCM, save and reopen the menu, then enter the key and model name. Built-in presets include OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, SiliconFlow, and others.

[b]To choose a different model, type its name manually.[/b] Any model list shown below the settings is a reference. A preset uses its default model when Model name is empty; that default is not necessarily free. For a free model or trial, choose a currently eligible model explicitly and check the provider's limits. Pricing, quotas, and availability can change.

[b]Using a local model[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://ollama.com/]Ollama[/url]: install Ollama, download a model (for example, [font=Courier New]ollama pull qwen3:8b[/font]), and make sure the service is running. Choose Ollama in GMCM and enter the installed model's name.[/*]
[*]LM Studio: download and load a model, start its local API server, then choose LM Studio and use the model name shown by the server.[/*]
[*]The local presets do not require an API key. Speed and response quality depend on your hardware and model. Installing this mod alone does not install or start a model server.[/*]
[/list][b]Custom endpoints[/b]
Choose OpenAI-compatible for a compatible third-party server, then enter its API key, exact model name, and the base URL supplied by that service. For llama.cpp, select llama.cpp (local), enter the full server endpoint (for example, http://127.0.0.1:8080/completion), and match Prompt format to your model.

[b]Changing providers[/b]
Save and reopen the menu, then check the connection fields again. Old model names and custom server addresses are not automatically cleared. To use a preset's defaults, leave those values empty. If an old server address is hidden in the new provider's menu, close the game and clear ServerAddress in config.json.

Start with [b]Thinking level: Auto[/b]. This setting applies to dialogue and background tasks, and is adapted to the selected model. Higher settings can mean longer waits; they are not required for ordinary conversations.

No GMCM? Launch once, exit the game, and edit [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/config.json[/font].

[size=4][b]Gameplay & settings — make it your own[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]Gameplay & settings — make it your own[/b][/size][/center]
[b]Memories and relationships[/b]
NPCs can remember preferences, promises, shared events, and unresolved tension. Later replies draw on relevant memories and conversation history; relationship impressions refresh after meaningful interactions. The Memory Book brings relationships, memories, conversations, and shared moments together. AI responses still depend on the model you use.

[b]Requests, gifts, and outings[/b]
Clearly accepted item requests appear in the vanilla quest log. Deliver the correct item to complete them. Gifts, money, and outings depend on friendship, cooldowns, available items, and the current game situation; a promise in dialogue does not bypass these checks.

Invite an NPC to a supported location for a short outing. The Desert, Ginger Island, Movie Theater, and Spa are supported once unlocked in your save. NPCs can stroll alongside you and make occasional comments before returning to their schedules. Festivals, story events, sleep, weather, and unsafe routes can prevent an outing.

[b]Useful GMCM settings[/b]
[list]
[*][b]AI for normal right-click dialogue:[/b] optional; leave it off to keep vanilla right-click conversations.[/*]
[*][b]AI world actions:[/b] turn this off to keep AI conversations without effects such as gifts, money, or outings.[/*]
[*][b]Help requests, small gifts, and AI dialogue frequencies:[/b] adjust how often these happen. Hotkeys and disabled NPCs are also configurable.[/*]
[*][b]Concise prompt options:[/b] can reduce context size; restore defaults if you prefer more character or world detail.[/*]
[/list]If AI dialogue was disabled when the game started, [b]restart the game after enabling it[/b]. Saving a new key, model, or address normally does not require a restart.

Advanced options for outings, money, passive behaviors, memory limits, and logs are in config.json. Close the game before editing it. See the [url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/blob/rewrite/README.en.md]full settings reference[/url] for the field names.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer, SVE & custom NPCs[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]Multiplayer, SVE & custom NPCs[/b][/size][/center]
[b]Online / LAN co-op[/b]
[list]
[*]The host and every participating farmhand need the same mod version and their own AI provider settings. Each player's requests use their own connection; the host's API key is not shared.[/*]
[*]The host's save manages shared NPC memories and relationship state. Farmhands keep their own conversation history; the Memory Book requests the other pages from the host.[/*]
[*]Farmhand gifts and item requests are checked by the host. Approved requests appear in that farmhand's quest log, and the host verifies delivery.[/*]
[*]Companion outings are host-only. Secondary split-screen players do not currently have AI dialogue support.[/*]
[*]If the host lacks the mod, synchronization is disabled, or protocol versions differ, farmhands fall back to local mode without updating the host's NPC memories.[/*]
[/list][b]NPC and expansion support[/b]
[list]
[*]Vanilla and SVE character information is built in, in English and Simplified Chinese. SVE itself is optional.[/*]
[*]Other custom NPCs can use game data and a generic fallback. Dedicated support for every expansion is not guaranteed; East Scarp does not have a dedicated, hand-tuned integration.[/*]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village NPCs are currently excluded from AI dialogue.[/b] Its character text and locations are also excluded from AI context. Adding a profile or biography does not remove this restriction.[/*]
[*]Community authors can add lightweight npc_profiles or complete, localized npc_bios. See the [url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/blob/rewrite/LivingNPCs/npc_bios/README.en.md]biography guide[/url].[/*]
[*]LivingNPCs respects content authors' AI-use permissions; restricted content-pack text is not copied into prompts.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]FAQ — when something does not work[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]FAQ — when something does not work[/b][/size][/center]
[b]Nothing happens when I try to chat.[/b]
Stand near the NPC, close other menus, and hold the configured hotkey while interacting. Check that the engine is enabled and your connection is configured. Look for a SMAPI warning about old ValleyTalk or missing settings. Free-roam festival conversations are supported; performances and timed contests do not allow typed dialogue.

[b]The connection fails.[/b]
401/403 usually means a key or permission problem. 429 usually means rate limits or insufficient quota. For "model not found", check the exact name and account access. For timeouts, check the endpoint, network, server, and request timeout. Changing providers can leave an old model name or server address behind; see AI Setup above. A failed self-check does not permanently disable dialogue; a real conversation tries again.

[b]Replies are slow or expensive.[/b]
Try a faster model, a lower supported thinking level, fewer automatic AI lines, or concise prompt options. Inspect usage with [font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens[/font]. Dialogue, gift mail, relationship impressions, and other background work can all contribute to usage.

[b]An NPC agreed, but nothing happened.[/b]
Check the quest log for accepted requests. Gifts and outings also require local eligibility checks; conversation text alone does not guarantee an action. Include the exchange and game situation when reporting a mismatch.

[b]The farmhand's Memory Book stays on Loading.[/b]
Check that the host is connected and has the same mod version, then close and reopen the book. The shared pages need a response from the host.

[size=4][b]Privacy, usage & support[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]Privacy, usage & support[/b][/size][/center]
Your configured AI service receives your message and the context needed to answer, which can include NPC information, relationships, game state, recent conversations, and relevant memories. Your provider determines its data handling and billing.

Your API key is stored in [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/config.json[/font] and is not included in the mod's diagnostic logs or exports. Do not share that file with its key intact.

Local conversation records and diagnostic logs may contain private dialogue. Review them before sharing. Set [font=Courier New]ExportAiResponseLogs[/font] to false in config.json to stop AI diagnostic logging; this does not disable conversation-history storage. Keep your history and multiplayer folders when updating.

[b]Useful SMAPI console commands[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens[/font] — inspect AI usage.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_debug near[/font] — inspect a nearby NPC's current state.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_prompt near[/font] — inspect the context prepared for a conversation.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_export near[/font] — export a diagnostic report for a nearby NPC.[/*]
[/list]The [url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/blob/rewrite/README.en.md]full guide[/url] also covers advanced commands. Forget, reset, and purge commands delete data; back up your save before using them.

For a bug report, include the mod/game/SMAPI versions, the NPC and location, what you did, what happened, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]parsed SMAPI log[/url]. Suggestions and translation feedback are welcome in Posts, too. Remove private conversation content and credentials before sharing reports.[/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]AI 设置——服务商、密钥与本地模型[/b][/size][/center]
[b]使用在线 AI 服务[/b]
在服务商的 API 控制台创建 API Key，并确认你的账户可以使用哪些模型。在 GMCM 中选择对应服务商，保存并重新打开菜单，然后填写密钥和模型名。内置预设包括 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Claude、Gemini、OpenRouter、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、SiliconFlow 等。

[b]如果想换用其他模型，请手动输入模型名。[/b]设置下方显示的型号列表仅供参考。“模型名”留空时，会使用该预设的默认模型；默认模型不一定免费。如果要使用免费模型或试用额度，请明确选择当前符合条件的模型，并核对服务商的使用限制。价格、额度和可用性都可能变化。

[b]使用本地模型[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://ollama.com/]Ollama[/url]：安装 Ollama，下载模型（例如运行 [font=Courier New]ollama pull qwen3:8b[/font]），并确认服务正在运行。在 GMCM 中选择 Ollama，填写已经安装的模型名称。[/*]
[*]LM Studio：下载并加载模型，启动本地 API 服务，然后选择 LM Studio，使用服务端显示的模型名称。[/*]
[*]本地服务预设不要求 API Key。速度和回复质量取决于你的硬件与模型。仅安装本 Mod，不会自动安装或启动模型服务器。[/*]
[/list][b]自定义服务地址[/b]
如果使用兼容接口的第三方服务器，请选择 OpenAI-compatible，填写该服务的 API Key、准确的模型名称，以及服务方提供的基础地址。使用 llama.cpp 时，请选择 llama.cpp (local)，填写完整服务端点（例如 http://127.0.0.1:8080/completion），并让“提示词模板”与所用模型匹配。

[b]切换服务商[/b]
保存并重新打开菜单，再次检查连接字段。旧模型名和自定义服务器地址不会自动清空。如果想使用预设默认值，请将对应字段留空。如果新服务商的菜单中隐藏了旧服务器地址，请退出游戏，在 config.json 中清空 ServerAddress。

建议先使用[b]思考档位：自动（Auto）[/b]。该设置同时用于对话和后台任务，并会根据所选模型适配。更高的档位可能意味着更长的等待时间，日常聊天不必使用高档位。

没有安装 GMCM？先启动一次游戏，再退出并编辑 [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/config.json[/font]。

[size=4][b]升级指南——0.2.0 与更早版本[/b][/size]
[b]从 0.2.0 升级到 0.2.1[/b]
退出游戏，备份存档和 LivingNPCs 文件夹。将压缩包解压到 Mods，合并并覆盖已有的 LivingNPCs 文件夹。保留 config.json、data、联机历史记录、conversation_logs，以及自己添加的 npc_profiles 或 npc_bios 文件。不要删除整个文件夹，也不要同时加载两份 Mod。

[b]从 0.1.x 升级：先处理旧 ValleyTalk 文件夹[/b]
[list=1]
[*]退出游戏，备份存档和旧 Mod 文件夹。[/*]
[*]在第一次启动新版之前，将旧版[b]最外层[/b]的 [font=Courier New]Mods/ValleyTalk[/font] 文件夹改名为 [font=Courier New]Mods/.ValleyTalk[/font]。请将它保留在 Mods 内，方便迁移器找到。若原结构为 ValleyTalk/ValleyTalk，改名最外层文件夹。不要改名 LivingNPCs。[/*]
[*]将压缩包解压到 Mods，合并并覆盖已有的 LivingNPCs 文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动，载入每个需要迁移的存档，之后正常保存一次。多人存档必须由主机完成这一步。[/*]
[/list]兼容的设置、对话记忆、聊天记录和 token 用量记录可以导入。请保留 .ValleyTalk 备份，直到确认迁移结果正常。没有旧数据可导入时，可能不会显示迁移提示。

如果旧 ValleyTalk 仍在加载，AI 对话和迁移都会被停用。如果在改名旧文件夹之前已经启动过新版，可能需要手动填写连接设置。若出现部分迁移失败，请保留备份，并在反馈时附上 SMAPI 日志。

LivingNPCs 0.2.1 已包含自己的对话引擎。本 Mod 不需要 ValleyTalk 或 Content Patcher。

[size=4][b]玩法与设置——按你的喜好游玩[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]玩法与设置——按你的喜好游玩[/b][/size][/center]
[b]记忆与关系[/b]
NPC 可以记住偏好、承诺、共同经历和尚未化解的矛盾。之后的回复会参考相关记忆与对话历史；关系印象会在重要互动后更新。记忆手册将关系、记忆、对话和共同经历汇集在一起。AI 回复的表现仍取决于你使用的模型。

[b]求助、礼物与出游[/b]
你明确接受的物品求助会显示在原版任务日志中。交付正确物品即可完成。礼物、金钱和出游需要满足好感、冷却时间、可用物品及当前游戏情境等条件；对话中的承诺不会绕过这些检查。

邀请 NPC 前往受支持的地点短途出游。沙漠、姜岛、电影院与温泉在你的存档中解锁后均受支持。NPC 可以与你并肩漫步，偶尔说上几句话，然后回到原有日程。节日、剧情事件、睡眠、天气和不安全的路线都可能阻止出游。

[b]常用 GMCM 设置[/b]
[list]
[*][b]普通右键也用 AI 对话：[/b]可选；保持关闭即可保留普通右键的原版对话。[/*]
[*][b]AI 影响世界：[/b]关闭后可保留 AI 对话，同时停止礼物、金钱或出游等效果。[/*]
[*][b]主动求助、小礼物与 AI 台词频率：[/b]调整这些内容出现的频率。快捷键和禁用 AI 的 NPC 也可以设置。[/*]
[*][b]精简提示选项：[/b]可减少上下文长度；如果希望保留更多角色或世界细节，请恢复默认设置。[/*]
[/list]如果启动游戏时 AI 对话处于关闭状态，[b]启用后请重启游戏[/b]。保存新的 Key、模型或地址通常无需重启。

有关出游、金钱、被动行为、记忆上限和日志的高级选项都在 config.json 中。编辑前请先关闭游戏。字段名称参见[url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/blob/rewrite/README.en.md]完整设置参考[/url]。

[size=4][b]多人联机、SVE 与自定义 NPC[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]多人联机、SVE 与自定义 NPC[/b][/size][/center]
[b]在线／局域网合作[/b]
[list]
[*]主机和所有参与联机的副机都需要安装相同版本的 Mod，并配置自己的 AI 提供商。每位玩家的请求都使用自己的连接；主机的 API Key 不会共享。[/*]
[*]主机存档负责管理共享的 NPC 记忆与关系状态。副机保留自己的对话历史；记忆手册的其他页面会向主机请求数据。[/*]
[*]副机的礼物与物品求助由主机检查。通过验证的求助会出现在该副机的任务日志中，交付也由主机核验。[/*]
[*]陪伴出游仅限主机。分屏副屏玩家目前不支持 AI 对话。[/*]
[*]如果主机未安装 Mod、同步被关闭，或协议版本不同，副机会退回本地模式，且不会更新主机的 NPC 记忆。[/*]
[/list][b]NPC 与扩展支持[/b]
[list]
[*]原版与 SVE 的人物资料已内置，并提供英文与简体中文内容。SVE 本身是可选的。[/*]
[*]其他自定义 NPC 可以使用游戏数据和通用回退资料。无法保证每个扩展都有专属支持；East Scarp 尚无经过专门调校的适配。[/*]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village 的 NPC 目前不在 AI 对话支持范围内。[/b]其角色文本和地点也不会进入 AI 上下文。添加人物资料或传记不会解除这项限制。[/*]
[*]社区作者可以添加轻量的 npc_profiles，或完整的本地化 npc_bios。请参阅[url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/blob/rewrite/LivingNPCs/npc_bios/README.en.md]传记编写指南[/url]。[/*]
[*]LivingNPCs 尊重内容作者对 AI 使用的许可；受到限制的内容包文本不会被复制进提示词。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]常见问题——功能无法正常工作时[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]常见问题——功能无法正常工作时[/b][/size][/center]
[b]尝试聊天时没有反应。[/b]
站到 NPC 附近，关闭其他菜单，并在交互时按住已设置的热键。检查 AI 引擎是否启用、连接是否配置完成。查看 SMAPI 是否提示旧版 ValleyTalk 或设置缺失的问题。节日中可以自由走动的阶段支持聊天；表演和限时比赛期间不允许输入对话。

[b]连接失败。[/b]
401/403 通常表示密钥或权限有问题。429 通常表示触发限流或额度不足。遇到“找不到模型”时，请核对准确的模型名及账户使用权限。遇到超时时，请检查服务端点、网络、服务器和请求超时设置。切换提供商后，旧模型名或服务器地址可能仍然保留；请参阅上方的 AI 设置说明。自检失败不会永久禁用对话；实际聊天时会再次尝试。

[b]回复很慢或费用很高。[/b]
尝试更快的模型、模型支持的较低思考档位、减少自动生成的 AI 台词，或使用精简提示选项。使用 [font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens[/font] 查看用量。对话、礼物信、关系印象和其他后台任务都可能产生用量。

[b]NPC 答应了，但什么也没发生。[/b]
在任务日志中查看已接受的求助。礼物和出游也需要通过本地条件校验；仅凭对话文本无法保证动作一定执行。反馈言行不一致的问题时，请附上相关对话和当时的游戏情况。

[b]副机的记忆手册一直显示“加载中”。[/b]
检查主机是否在线、是否安装了相同版本的 Mod，然后关闭并重新打开手册。共享页面需要收到主机的响应。

[size=4][b]隐私、用量与支持[/b][/size]
[center][size=4][b]隐私、用量与支持[/b][/size][/center]
你配置的 AI 服务会收到你的消息和回答所需的上下文，其中可能包括 NPC 信息、关系、游戏状态、近期对话及相关记忆。数据处理方式与计费规则由服务商决定。

你的 API 密钥保存在 [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/config.json[/font] 中，不会包含在 Mod 的诊断日志或导出内容里。请勿分享仍含有密钥的配置文件。

本地对话记录和诊断日志可能包含私人对话。分享前请先检查。在 config.json 中将 [font=Courier New]ExportAiResponseLogs[/font] 设为 false，可停止记录 AI 诊断日志；这不会关闭对话历史的保存功能。更新时请保留历史记录文件夹和 multiplayer 文件夹。

[b]常用 SMAPI 控制台命令[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens[/font]——查看 AI 用量。[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_debug near[/font]——查看附近 NPC 的当前状态。[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_prompt near[/font]——查看为对话准备的上下文。[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_export near[/font]——导出附近 NPC 的诊断报告。[/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs/blob/rewrite/README.en.md]完整指南[/url]中也介绍了高级命令。Forget、reset 和 purge 命令会删除数据；使用前请备份存档。

提交 Bug 报告时，请提供 Mod／游戏／SMAPI 版本、NPC 及地点、你的操作、实际发生的情况，以及一份 [url=https://smapi.io/log]解析后的 SMAPI 日志[/url]。也欢迎在 Posts 提出建议与翻译反馈。分享报告前，请移除私人对话内容及凭据信息。

感谢 Stardew Valley、SMAPI、GMCM，以及所有提供想法、参与测试和翻译的人。[url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs]GitHub 上的源码与指南[/url]。[/spoiler]

Thanks to Stardew Valley, SMAPI, GMCM, and everyone contributing ideas, testing, and translations. [url=https://github.com/Nyx-Amanises/StardewLivingNPCs]Source & guides on GitHub[/url].
